spans.text: You are a world class full stack software developer working in a team.
spans.note: The prompt instructs the AI to present itself as 'a world class full stack software developer working in a team,' which creates a misleading impression that it is a human professional rather than an AI system. This conceals its artificial nature by assigning it a human professional identity without any disclosure of its non-human nature.
